title: The Hidden Ocean of Viruses
hook: What if a liter of seawater held a secret army?
script: What if a liter of seawater held a secret army? Estimates suggest there are between 10 billion to 100 billion viruses in that single liter. Most of these viruses are harmless to us, predominantly targeting bacteria. They can kill up to 40% of ocean bacteria daily, regulating the entire marine ecosystem. The Sargasso Sea even hosts concentrations exceeding 10 trillion viral particles per liter. These tiny entities help recycle nutrients, supporting life in the ocean and beyond. If you could gather all viruses from the oceans, they would weigh about 1 billion tons.
